description: This Java class defines an Akka actor responsible for managing and updating a distributed cache of blocked namespaces within the Eclipse Ditto project. It handles subscribing to relevant namespace-blocking commands and processes such commands to update the cache accordingly, while also managing error handling and logging.

classes.name: BlockedNamespacesUpdater
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages a cache of blocked namespaces by subscribing to relevant namespace commands and updating the cache accordingly.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for instantiating the BlockedNamespacesUpdater actor with specified dependencies.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the message handling behavior for the actor, including different message types.

methods.name: blockNamespace
methods.description: Handles the BlockNamespace command by adding the namespace to the cache and responding to the sender.

methods.name: unblockNamespace
methods.description: Handles the UnblockNamespace command by removing the namespace from the cache and responding to the sender.

methods.name: handleError
methods.description: Handles exceptions that occur during cache updates, logs the error, and sends an error message back to the sender.
